name: Wolfpine Village Candidate Extensions
purpose: Supplemental modernized Infinity Engine candidate assets produced after the starter kit for Wolfpine settlement dressing and transition readability.

source_policy.notes: These entries track supplemental candidates from the 2026-05-06 production batch. Do not mark accepted until cleaned PNGs exist at the intended paths and pass visual/layout review.

global_acceptance_checks: Painted or pre-rendered look, not pixel art.
Muted natural Wolfpine palette with readable warm daylight.
No text or UI baked into the asset.
Source and license/generation notes are recorded before production use.

placement_rules: Use near the storehouse, market edge, inn service side, or guard post.
Do not block doors, required routes, or hotspot approach arcs.
Break into smaller barrel, crate, and sack variants if repetition becomes obvious.
acceptance_checks: Reads as practical village supplies at game scale.
Perspective matches the Wolfpine ground plane.
Cluster has a clean footprint that is easy to block for collision.
No individual object looks modern or overly clean.
assets.production_notes: Useful supplemental clutter; split into barrel/crate/sack variants before heavy canonical reuse.

placement_rules: Use along road edges, storehouse approaches, or caravan-related scene dressing.
Do not place across the south road to main square route.
Keep enough clear space around wheels and shafts for believable collision.
acceptance_checks: Readable as a loaded village cart at game scale.
Wheel perspective matches the pseudo-isometric camera.
Cargo does not include readable labels or modern materials.
Can support Missing Caravan visual storytelling without becoming scene-specific.
assets.production_notes: Useful village/road prop for caravan and supply-pressure dressing; keep modular and avoid blocking required routes.

placement_rules: Use to frame the north chapel path or chapel yard transition.
Do not use as a full wall or door unless future area data defines that transition.
Never obscure the chapel path hotspot or its visible route.
acceptance_checks: Reads as an old stone chapel-path marker, not a house facade.
Perspective and ground contact match Wolfpine Village.
Does not contain readable text or religious symbols that imply unsupported lore.
Makes the chapel exit more readable without blocking movement.
assets.production_notes: Strong chapel-path marker; good candidate for transition readability once cleaned PNG is committed.

placement_rules: Use beside the blacksmith facade or in a forge yard, not in front of the door.
Keep tool clutter grouped so collision and hotspot access remain readable.
Can be split into anvil, tool rack, and bench pieces for finer scene dressing.
acceptance_checks: Forge identity is clear without labels.
Tool shapes read at game scale without excessive visual noise.
Perspective matches the blacksmith facade and ground plane.
Does not block the blacksmith door or work-yard approach.
assets.production_notes: Good forge dressing candidate; split into smaller prop variants if repeated in multiple areas.
